contract.claim_reference_rule: A lane may cite a registered claim ID, but mathematical credit is bounded by that claim's authority_status, PROVES, DOES_NOT_PROVE, source locks, and audit receipt.
contract.active_frontier_rule: active_frontier_refs point into ACTIVE-FRONTIER.json and express current OWNER/ATTACKS/CONSUMES routing only; they do not make EX1-EX6 separate mathematical Stages and do not grant proof credit. A stopped lane with no current active attack may carry an empty active_frontier_refs list only under the verifier's explicit stopped-lane gate.
contract.promotion_rule: EX -> MAIN requires an AUDITED terminal EX claim plus a separate explicit current-target promotion adapter claim. LANE-ADAPTERS.json itself never promotes.
contract.purpose: External reference map only. Existing MAIN-STATE files remain authoritative for routing and are not rewritten or promoted by this adapter.
contract.scratch_rule: Scratch results are not claim dependencies for MAIN/EX promotion. They must first become a retained PROVISIONAL claim with exact source locks.
contract.new_lane_enrollment_rule: Any new Stage32 EX lane must be added here with exact state_path, startup_path, claim_refs, and active_frontier_refs before it can promote mathematical credit to MAIN. A stopped lane may enroll with empty active_frontier_refs only while promotion_blocked_without_active_claim=true; re-entry requires ACTIVE_FRONTIER_REMAP before promotion.
